# Transit Fabric testnet (tester v0.1.0-tester.4.3)

> Transit Fabric is a decentralized network fabric run as a Bittensor subnet. It is on Bittensor testnet, subnet 611, and the current release is v0.1.0-tester.4.3 (a pre-release). Nodes carry overlay traffic for each other, route solvers compete on the route table, and validators measure both and set weights. Testnet only: never use mainnet keys or real TAO. Linking a node to a hotkey needs the human to sign: stop and hand off. Verify checksums before running anything you download.

The command-line tools are still named `bwos` in this testnet. tester.4.3 is a fix for validators and for anyone running a shadow validator: validators and shadows now get the commitment manifests that nodes forward promptly (before, they arrived a window or more late and shadows could never reach MATCH on Mechanism 0), two-source chain reads tolerate up to 6 blocks of lag without flapping, and the epoch-guard wait follows the best block. No scoring change. Nodes and solvers don't need to update; container operators still on old arguments should recreate the container, not just restart it. tester.4.2 was a small hotfix for validators only: a validator now holds back a weight commit that would land within 8 blocks of the next epoch, so every validator's commit lands in the same reveal epoch (no scoring change). Nodes and solvers don't need to update. tester.4.1 was mostly for validators: the subnet owner's on-chain validator allowlist (ADR-0078), parsed from testnet block 8,481,240 (about 2026-11-19 19:40 UTC, report-only) and in force from block 8,495,640 (about 2026-11-21 19:40 UTC), and two-source chain reads that tolerate a lagging source. For anyone: shadow mode (`bwos-validator shadow`) recomputes the validators' weights from public data; a `MISMATCH` is bounty-eligible (https://transitfabric.xyz/redteam/shadow-validator.html). Nodes need no change; upgrading `fabric-sense` before block 8,495,640 keeps a node's anchor rebuild identical to the validators' chain-only set. tester.4 built a current validator set at a node's first start, fixed NAT dial-ins and validator fetches, and switches on scoring version 1 at testnet block 8,493,120 (about 2026-11-21 11:15 UTC). `bwos doctor --json` (health checks with registry codes), `bwos report` (a redacted Issue body) and an agent skill came in tester.3. Agent skill (Claude Code): `/plugin marketplace add transitfabric/releases`, then `/plugin install transit-fabric@transitfabric`. The bug bounty opens soon; reports are welcome now.

Full rules for agents: https://transitfabric.xyz/AGENTS.md

## Downloads and checks

- [Release v0.1.0-tester.4.3](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases/tag/v0.1.0-tester.4.3): binaries for Linux x86_64 and aarch64 (`bwos-node`, `bwos`, `bwos-probe`, `bwos-solver`, `bwos-validator`, `minimal_solver`), the no-root container image, router images, the link page, `install.sh`.
- [SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases/download/v0.1.0-tester.4.3/SHA256SUMS): checksum every file you download against this, and compare the hash of SHA256SUMS itself with the one in the announcement. Releases are not signed yet.
- [MANIFEST.json](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases/download/v0.1.0-tester.4.3/MANIFEST.json): the commit, the toolchain and the file list.
- [All releases](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases)

## Quick start

- [Quick start](https://transitfabric.xyz/quickstart.html): wallet, download, node, peer, check. Start here.
- [QUICKSTART.md](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases/download/v0.1.0-tester.4.3/QUICKSTART.md): the same, as a release asset.

## Rules for agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://transitfabric.xyz/AGENTS.md): checksum verification, no mainnet, the human-binding handoff, how to report.

## Reporting

- [Bug report or Finding (Issues)](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/issues/new/choose): ordinary bugs, and findings with a reproduction. The Bug report form asks for the version, node kind, `bwos doctor --json` output and the `bwos report` Issue body. Tick "Filed by an agent" on either form (label `agent-filed`).
- [Private advisory](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/security/advisories/new): security findings and exploits. Agents use the API: `POST /repos/transitfabric/releases/security-advisories/reports` (GitHub private vulnerability reporting, enabled on this repository), with `summary` and `description`, and optionally `severity`.
- [Finding template](https://transitfabric.xyz/redteam/FINDING.md): front matter and sections. Use it as the Issue body or the advisory description.
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

## Red-team pack and bounty

- [Run a shadow validator](https://transitfabric.xyz/redteam/shadow-validator.html): recompute the weights from public data and compare with what validators revealed; a `MISMATCH` is bounty-eligible. No wallet, UID or TAO.
- [Red-team pack](https://transitfabric.xyz/redteam/index.html): scoring, measurement, receipts, capacity-bonds, identity and encoding specs, the threat model, the whitepaper, and the simulator (`bwos-sim`) with how to reproduce a finding in it.
- [Bounty](https://transitfabric.xyz/bounty.html): scope, tiers, rules. Opening soon.
- [Register for credit](https://transitfabric.xyz/claim.html): a human signs one message with a wallet. The message attests they are 18 or older, or the age of majority where they live, whichever is higher, and accepts the [Terms](https://transitfabric.xyz/terms.html) and [Privacy Policy](https://transitfabric.xyz/privacy.html). Agents don't do this step.
- [Leaderboard](https://transitfabric.xyz/leaderboard.html)

## Findings sandbox (no GitHub account)

- [Upload page](https://submit.transitfabric.xyz): private, no account, no bounty credit. Agents: `curl -sS -F file=@finding.md -F age_attested=yes -F terms_version=1 https://submit.transitfabric.xyz/upload` (optional `-F attachment=@repro.zip`). `age_attested=yes` states that the human sending it is 18 or older, or the age of majority where they live, whichever is higher, and accepts the [Terms](https://transitfabric.xyz/terms.html) and [Privacy Policy](https://transitfabric.xyz/privacy.html); ask them, never assume it. The reply is JSON with a receipt ID. Limit: 10 uploads a day per address.
- [Testnet rules](https://transitfabric.xyz/testnet-rules.html): what testnet work may earn; final, version 2.1, effective 2026-11-17.
- [Operator guide](https://transitfabric.xyz/operator-guide.html): what pays, what your host must allow, how to declare honestly; read before you choose a setup.
- [FAQ](https://transitfabric.xyz/faq.html): customers, how capacity is bought, operator costs and the 95th-percentile bill, capacity tests.
